barriers.description: Qualitative analysis was performed by a single reviewer, limiting analytic redundancy and rigor in deriving themes from interviews.
barriers.justification: Having only a solitary coder reduced the designers' capacity to robustly manage user understanding and to confidently translate insights into user requirements, hindering analysis and specification workloads.
barriers.reference_excerpt: A solitary reviewer analyzed the coding, which was validated through member checking of adolescent health and endocrinology specialists at SickKids Hospital.

barriers.description: The pilot used a single-site, small convenience sample with no control group, limiting the study's generalizability and the designers' ability to evaluate outcomes robustly.
barriers.justification: The limited sample and site constrained the designers' ability to evaluate the intervention and to generate generalizable evidence needed for iterative refinement and specifying broader user requirements.
barriers.reference_excerpt: The pilot was limited to a single-site, small convenience sample with no control group, which limited our ability to generalize the findings and determine the efficacy of the intervention fully.

barriers.description: Participant dropout and missing baseline meter data reduced the analyzable sample, undermining planned outcome analyses.
barriers.justification: Incomplete data and attrition directly hindered the designers' and researchers' ability to evaluate the design's effectiveness and to integrate evaluation findings into subsequent iterations.
barriers.reference_excerpt: Of these, 2 did not complete the full 12-week pilot study and 6 did not have sufficient baseline data from the meters for us to perform the analysis for the primary outcome measure.

barriers.description: Limited deployment and low/uneven engagement with the in-app community made it difficult to assess the social networking component's value.
barriers.justification: Insufficient scale and skewed participation constrained the designers' ability to evaluate the community feature with users, hindering evaluation and decisions about integrating social features into the product.
barriers.reference_excerpt: We also have few findings on the effect of the community aspect of the intervention, and its direct value is difficult to ascertain. Only through wider deployment can the use of these social networking aspects be properly evaluated.

barriers.description: The reward mechanism relied on iTunes redemption codes, raising concerns about the long-term sustainability of the incentive model.
barriers.justification: Sustainability constraints on the reward system limit the designers' ability to plan long-term deployment and iterative refinement of gamification features, affecting both design solution production and future evaluation.
barriers.reference_excerpt: The long-term sustainability of using iTunes redemption codes as a reward is an issue that requires attention.
